Trunk meets the ground around x25. No ground mound, no pedestal, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no text. Exact native 1px density, hard opaque-or-transparent pixel edges, clean clusters, small restrained palette. Do not shrink a full mature tree, do not add a glow.
